meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Git 专家流程处理仓库操作:默认把改动拆成多个原子提交,先检测仓库已有的提交风格和语言再照此写信息,也能整理提交历史、查找某处改动是何时由谁引入。
howto.when: 当你提到「commit」「rebase」「squash」等关键词,或要求查找某处改动何时加入、是谁写的时触发,并据此进入对应模式。

say.note: 先分析仓库提交风格,再拆成多个原子提交

say.text: 把最近这几个提交压缩成一个
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式整理历史

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁、什么时候改的
say.note: 进入历史搜索模式定位提交

howto.what_en: After install, Claude handles git work as an expert: it defaults to splitting changes into multiple atomic commits, detects the repo's existing commit style and language before writing messages, and can clean up history or find when and who introduced a change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "commit", "rebase", "squash" and similar terms, or ask when a change was added or who wrote it, then switches into the matching mode.

say_en.note: Detects repo commit style, splits into atomic commits

say_en.text: Squash my last few commits into one
say_en.note: Switches into rebase mode to rewrite history

say_en.text: Who wrote this line, and when?
say_en.note: Enters history search mode to locate the commit
